description:
Where things stand and what to do next; start and resume here.

Always reports the account: plan, credits, credits held by running jobs,
and credits_available to spend. project_id adds the project's settings,
each step's state and web link, jobs with readable errors, export_url
and next_step. channel_id reports the channel style instead:
analysis_done, inputs_stale, templates, templates_stale and next_step.
Without API access it reports only the account and
subscription_needed: pass that on to the user.

channel_id.description: Report this channel's style instead of a project

wait.description: Wait up to about 50 seconds for the jobs in scope to finish, then report only credits, jobs, step states and next_step; call again if some still run
